title: Junior Core Mathematics • Objective Mastery Series (Set 39)
subject: Mathematics

questions.prompt: Expand and simplify completely: $$(3x + 2y)(2x + y)$$.
questions.hint: Multiply each term in the first bracket by each term in the second: $3x(2x + y) + 2y(2x + y)$.

questions.prompt: Find the missing binary number $$x$$ in the subtraction: $$111010_{\text{two}} - x = 10111_{\text{two}}$$.
questions.hint: $$x = 111010_{\text{two}} - 10111_{\text{two}}$$. In base ten: $58 - 23 = 35$. Convert 35 back to base two.

questions.prompt: If set $$S = \{2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16\}$$, find the truth set of $$x - 4 \ge 8$$.
questions.hint: $$x \ge 8 + 4 = 12$$. Filter set S for values greater than or equal to 12.
questions.workedSolution: $$x \ge 12$$. Within set S, elements that satisfy $x \ge 12$ are {12, 14, 16}.

questions.prompt: Which of the following geometric plane shapes has the LEAST number of lines of symmetry?
questions.hint: Count lines of symmetry: Equilateral = 3, Square = 4, Rectangle = 2, Isosceles triangle = 1.
questions.workedSolution: An isosceles triangle has only 1 line of symmetry, which is less than a rectangle (2), an equilateral triangle (3), and a square (4).

questions.prompt: Calculate $4\%$ of $\text{GH¢ } 3,500.00$.
Find the Highest Common Factor (HCF) of $24, 48,$ and $96$.
Arrange the fractions $$\frac{4}{5}, \, \frac{2}{3}, \, \frac{7}{10}$$ in ascending order.
Make $y$ the subject of the rational formula: $$\frac{1}{k} = \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y}$$.
Three siblings are aged $8, 12,$ and $20\text{ years}$. Find the ratio of their ages in its simplest form.
questions.hint: Divide each age by their highest common factor, 4.

questions.prompt: Eight students take $12\text{ days}$ to complete an agricultural project. How many days would $16\text{ students}$ take working at the exact same pace?
questions.hint: Total work = $8 \times 12 = 96\text{ student-days}$. Divide by 16 students.

questions.prompt: Which of the following fractional inequalities is TRUE?

Find the rule of the mapping:
$$1 \to 4, \quad 2 \to 7, \quad 3 \to 10, \quad x \to ?$$
questions.hint: Common difference is $7 - 4 = 3$. Output = $3x + c$. For $x = 1$, $3(1) + 1 = 4$.
questions.workedSolution: Gradient is 3. At $x = 1$, $y = 3(1) + 1 = 4$. The general rule is $$3x + 1$$.

questions.prompt: A motor vehicle travels at a steady speed of $80\text{ km/h}$. How far does it travel in $45\text{ minutes}$?
In an enlargement, the surface area of the object was multiplied by $81$ to obtain the area of the image. What is the linear scale factor of enlargement?
questions.hint: Area scale factor = $k^2 = 81$. Take the square root.

questions.prompt: Mr. Asare deposited $\text{GH¢ } 4,000.00$ at a simple interest rate of $15\%\text{ per annum}$ for $3\text{ years}$. Calculate the total interest earned.

The table shows goals scored by a team:

| Goals per match | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Frequency | 2 | 6 | 5 | 4 | 3 |

How many total goals did the team score in the season?
From the goals distribution in Question 16, what was the mean number of goals per match?
questions.hint: Mean = Total goals / Total matches. Total matches = $\sum f = 2 + 6 + 5 + 4 + 3 = 20$.

questions.prompt: What was the total number of matches played by the team in Question 16?
The probability of winning a prize in a raffle is $2/7$. What is the probability of NOT winning a prize?
Given column vectors $$u = \begin{pmatrix} 4 \\ -1 \end{pmatrix}$$ and $$v = \begin{pmatrix} -1 \\ 3 \end{pmatrix}$$, calculate $$u + 2v$$.
What is the value in base ten of the digit $3$ in the base five numeral $$234_{\text{five}}$$?
questions.hint: The digit 3 is in the 5s place ($5^1$). Value = $3 \times 5$.

questions.prompt: Each interior angle of a regular polygon is $140^\circ$. How many sides does this polygon have?
Simplify: $$\left(4\frac{1}{2} + 3\right) \div \left(3\frac{1}{4} - 2\right)$$.
Find the truth set of the inequality: $$2x - 5 > 9 - 5x$$.
In a rhombus with adjacent angles, one interior angle is $70^\circ$. Find the size of the obtuse interior angle.
questions.hint: Adjacent angles in a rhombus are supplementary ($180^\circ$).

questions.prompt: Four times a certain number is six more than the number. Find the number.
A merchant buys $300$ exercise books at $\text{GH¢ } 1.50$ each. What is the total cost of the books?
A salesperson earns a $5\%$ commission on all sales. If she sells goods worth $\text{GH¢ } 4,800.00$, calculate her commission.
If $$\frac{15}{25}$$ is equivalent to $$\frac{x + 2}{10}$$, find the value of $x$.
Write $48.962\text{ km}$ correct to three significant figures.
questions.hint: The 4th figure is 6 ($\ge 5$), so 48.9 rounds up to 49.0.
questions.workedSolution: Rounding to 3 significant figures: 48.962 becomes 49.0 km.

questions.prompt: Find $x$ if $$\frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{4} = 1$$.
The three-figure bearing of town $A$ from town $B$ is $065^\circ$. What is the bearing of town $B$ from town $A$?
In a geometric compass construction, arcs of equal radius drawn from endpoints $A$ and $B$ intersecting above and below segment $AB$ are used for:
options: Constructing the perpendicular bisector of segment AB
questions.correctAnswer: Constructing the perpendicular bisector of segment AB
questions.hint: Intersecting mediator arcs construct the perpendicular bisector.
questions.workedSolution: This standard construction produces the perpendicular bisector (mediator) of line segment AB.

questions.prompt: The dimensions of a rectangle are given in base two as length $$11_{\text{two}}\text{ cm}$$ and width $$10_{\text{two}}\text{ cm}$$. Find its perimeter in base two.
questions.hint: In base ten: length = 3 cm, width = 2 cm. Perimeter = 2(3 + 2) = 10 cm. Convert 10 to base two.

questions.prompt: A circle has a total area of $180\text{ cm}^2$. Calculate the area of a sector subtending an angle of $60^\circ$ at the centre.
In a parallelogram $ABCD$, angle $\angle ABC = 120^\circ$. What is the measure of consecutive angle $\angle BCD$?
questions.hint: Adjacent angles of a parallelogram are supplementary ($180^\circ$).

questions.prompt: Two parallel lines are crossed by a transversal line. Two interior angles on alternate sides of the transversal are known as:
questions.hint: They form a 'Z' shape and are equal in measure.
questions.workedSolution: By definition, angles on opposite sides of the transversal between the parallel lines are alternate angles.

questions.prompt: A surveyor standing $20\text{ m}$ away from the base of a vertical tower observes its top. If the tower is $20\text{ m}$ tall, what is the angle of elevation of the top?
In an isosceles triangle $ABC$, $|AB| = |AC|$ and the vertex angle $\angle BAC = 50^\circ$. Calculate the size of base angle $\angle ABC$.
Which of the following sets of measurements forms a right-angled triangle?
questions.workedSolution: $$5^2 + 12^2 = 25 + 144 = 169 = 13^2$$. By the converse of Pythagoras' theorem, this is a right-angled triangle.
